name: cc-executor-subagents
description: Fast multi-agent executor for Claude Code. Splits quick repo tasks into independent slices, supports pre-defined plan execution with Codex high plan-vs-output review, routes backend/front-end work through a per-project Project_Config (Codex/AGY/Claude Code, configurable), persists run state crash-safely with /executor resume, gates verification and completion proportionally to risk with deterministic validators, and reports without OpenSpec ceremony.
